opportunities.name: Booking.com flight search and select fastest
opportunities.description: On Booking.com Flights, search for a one-way or multi-city flight from {origin} to {destination} on {date(s)}, sort by Fastest, and select the top flight up to the traveller details step.
steps: Open the Flights tab
Pick trip type (one-way / multi-city)
Type the origin city in 'Where from?' and choose the suggestion
Type the destination city in 'Where to?' and choose the suggestion
For multi-city, add the next leg's origin and destination
Open the date picker and choose each leg's departure date
Set travellers if needed and click Done
Click Search
Sort by Fastest
Click 'See flight' on the top result, then Select
Choose the fare option and click Next

instances.values: Multi-city: New York -> Tokyo (1 Jun 2023), Tokyo -> New Delhi (5 Jun 2023), Fastest

opportunities.name: Expedia car rental search
opportunities.description: On Expedia Cars, search for a rental car at {pickup_location} (return to the same place) from {pickup_date} to {dropoff_date}, with optional times, then filter and sort the results.
steps: Click the Cars tab
Type the pick-up location and choose the suggestion
Keep drop-off as 'Same as pick-up'
Open the date picker, choose the pick-up and drop-off dates, and click Done
Optionally set pick-up and drop-off times
Click Search
Apply filter checkboxes
Optionally sort by Total Price

instances.values: JFK, Apr 3-6 2023, 9:00am-6:00pm, sort by Total Price

opportunities.name: Carnival cruise search
opportunities.description: On Carnival, search for cruises sailing to {destination} (optionally from {departure_port} in {month}) for {guests} guests.
steps: Open 'Sail To' and pick the destination
Optionally open 'Sail From' and pick the departure port
Optionally open 'Dates' and pick the month
Click SEARCH CRUISES
Optionally open 'Number of Guests' and set the count
Close the panel / apply

instances.values: Panama Canal from San Francisco, October 2024

opportunities.name: MTA planned service changes lookup by route
opportunities.description: On new.mta.info, open the Planned Work page, search for transit route {route}, and optionally pick a {date} to see service changes.
steps: Open Planned Work / Planned Service Changes
Type the route in 'Search Routes' and choose it
Optionally open the date picker, move to the right month, and choose the date

opportunities.name: SpotHero airport parking search
opportunities.description: On SpotHero, search for airport parking at {airport} from {start_date} to {end_date} and sort the results.
steps: Open the Airport tab
Type the airport name or code and choose the suggestion
Open Parking Start Date and choose the start and end dates
Sort the results (e.g. by Shuttle Time)
